faqs.question: Which Baker County calendar does this directory cover?
faqs.answer: This page covers Baker County School District in Florida. Its verified 2026-2027 calendar includes the annual PDF and the district’s student holiday guide; open that year for dates and dismissal details.

faqs.question: Have Baker County’s 2027-2028, 2028-2029 or 2029-2030 calendars been added?
faqs.answer: No. Those years have not been verified here. Use Baker County’s official Calendar page to look for new releases; the published 2026-2027 schedule does not establish dates for later years.

faqs.question: Does the district calendar include every school activity?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar sets district student dates. For a school’s performances, testing appointments, field trips or graduation instructions, check that school’s own calendar and messages to families.

editorialSummary.heading: School breaks, early dismissals and return dates
paragraphs: Baker County has seven one-hour early dismissal days for teacher PLCs in 2026-2027. Students leave two hours early on October 15 for Homecoming, December 18 before Christmas break, and May 28, the last day of school. All ten are school days, so families should follow the shortened dismissal schedule when arranging pickup.

Fall break is October 22-23, 2026, with classes resuming October 26. Students also have the full week of November 23-27 off for Thanksgiving. Christmas break begins December 21 and continues through January 4, 2027. January 4 is a teacher planning day, so students return Tuesday, January 5.

Good Friday, March 26, and Easter Monday, March 29, give students a four-day weekend in 2027. The district's spring break comes later, April 12-16. Students also have no classes on Monday, April 19, because of a planning day, and return April 20. Graduation is scheduled for May 21, while the last day of school for the district is May 28.
highlights: Seven PLC early dismissals (1 hour) and three other early dismissals (2 hours)
Christmas break: December 21-January 4; students return January 5
Spring break: April 12-16; students return April 20 after a planning day

about.dataSource: The 2026-2027 BCSD Calendar supplies the annual grid, academic reporting dates, graduation and the printed 176 student days. The Calendar page’s Student Holiday & Early Dismissal Guide supplies explicit return dates and the October 15 Homecoming dismissal. Its footer identifies the underlying district calendar as Board approved, without stating an approval date.
about.processing: The supplied PDF and live district download have identical SHA-256 hashes. Colors and legends were checked visually. Repeated Christmas entries form one continuous December 21-31 event; New Year’s Day and January 4 planning remain separate. The guide’s longer Christmas and spring spans appear as break summaries without duplicating closure events. There are 210 weekdays between the first and last student days and 34 without classes, consistent with the printed 176 days. Shortened school days count as attendance dates. Staff pre-planning, June planning and Memorial Day after the final student day are excluded.
about.updates: The annual PDF, full Student Holiday & Early Dismissal Guide image and district online Calendar were rechecked October 19, 2026. Both downloaded documents match the existing SHA-256 hashes. The guide confirms all ten early-dismissal dates and the published holiday return dates. The online calendar confirms October 12 as Planning / Columbus Day - No School and October 15 as a two-hour early dismissal; the annual PDF calls October 12 Planning Day and November 11 PD/Conference Day. The October 15 dismissal remains absent from the at-a-glance PDF. Neither a Board approval date nor a revision date is printed on the reviewed calendar materials, so those date fields remain unset.
about.disclaimer: Baker County’s announcements and your school provide changes after weather closures, campus dismissal times and graduation arrangements. The annual sources give dismissal offsets, not pickup clock times.

faqs.question: When do Baker County students go back to school in August 2026?
faqs.answer: Classes begin Monday, August 10, 2026. Teachers begin July 31 and have pre-planning August 3-7; students do not start on those staff dates.

faqs.question: When is the last day of school for Baker County in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the last day of school for Baker County students. Students attend that day but are dismissed two hours early.

faqs.question: When is fall break for Baker County schools in 2026?
faqs.answer: Fall break is Thursday, October 22, and Friday, October 23, 2026. Students have two school days off and return Monday, October 26.

faqs.question: Do students get the whole week off for Thanksgiving?
faqs.answer: Yes. Thanksgiving break runs Monday, November 23, through Friday, November 27, 2026. Classes resume Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When is Christmas break for Baker County schools in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: Christmas break runs from December 21, 2026, through January 4, 2027. January 4 is a teacher planning day with no student classes. Students return Tuesday, January 5. December 18 is the last school day before the break, with dismissal two hours early.

faqs.question: What are the spring break and return dates for Baker County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The annual calendar marks April 12-16 as Spring Break. Monday, April 19, is a planning day, so students remain off through April 19 and return Tuesday, April 20. The student holiday guide includes that planning day in its spring break range.

faqs.question: Are Good Friday and Easter Monday school holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Friday, March 26, and Monday, March 29, 2027, and return Tuesday, March 30. This is the Easter break. Spring break is later, in April; the school days between the two breaks are not days off.

faqs.question: What are the teacher planning days and PD days when Baker County students have no school?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes on September 21, October 12 and November 11, 2026, or January 4, February 1, March 12 and April 19, 2027. These seven dates are listed for planning, professional development or conferences. January 4 follows Christmas break, and April 19 follows spring break.

faqs.question: Do Baker County students have school on Columbus Day in 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, 2026, is a planning day with no classes for students. The district's online calendar identifies it as Planning / Columbus Day - No School. Classes are scheduled to resume Tuesday, October 13.

faqs.question: Do Baker County schools have classes on Veterans Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no school on Wednesday, November 11, 2026. The district lists the date as a Professional Development / Conference Day.

faqs.question: Do Baker County schools have classes on Labor Day 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Baker County students have no school on Monday, September 7, 2026, for Labor Day. Classes resume Tuesday, September 8.

faqs.question: Are Baker County schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 2027?
faqs.answer: Yes. Monday, January 18, 2027, is a school holiday for Martin Luther King Jr. Day. Students return Tuesday, January 19.

faqs.question: Do Baker County students have school on Presidents Day 2027?
faqs.answer: No. Students have no school on Monday, February 15, 2027, for Presidents Day. Classes resume Tuesday, February 16.

faqs.question: Which dates have one-hour early dismissal for teacher PLCs?
faqs.answer: Students are dismissed one hour early on August 19, September 2, September 30, November 4 and December 2, 2026, and January 27 and February 24, 2027. These are the seven teacher PLC early dismissal dates listed by the district.

faqs.question: Do Baker County schools dismiss students early every Wednesday?
faqs.answer: No. The district lists seven specific Wednesdays for teacher PLC early dismissals in 2026-2027. It does not list early dismissal as a weekly Wednesday schedule.

faqs.question: Which days have a two-hour early dismissal?
faqs.answer: The student guide lists three: Thursday, October 15, 2026, for Homecoming; Friday, December 18, 2026, before Christmas break; and Friday, May 28, 2027, the last day of school. Students attend on all three dates.

faqs.question: Is Homecoming a full school day in Baker County in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students attend school on Thursday, October 15, 2026, but are dismissed two hours early for Homecoming. It is not a full day off. The district lists this schedule in its Student Holiday & Early Dismissal Guide.

faqs.question: What time is early dismissal for Baker County schools?
faqs.answer: The district calendar lists early dismissals as either one or two hours before the regular dismissal time. It does not provide a single pickup time for every school. Check your child's school schedule for the exact dismissal and bus times.

faqs.question: When are progress reports scheduled?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are listed for September 4 and November 13, 2026, and February 5 and April 23, 2027. These are the mid-period progress updates, rather than the report-card dates.

faqs.question: What dates are report cards listed on the calendar?
faqs.answer: Report cards are listed on October 16, 2026, January 8, 2027, and March 19, 2027. No final report-card date is printed in the annual calendar; ask your school about the end-of-year release.

faqs.question: When do the first three nine-week grading periods finish?
faqs.answer: The calendar places the end of the first nine weeks on October 9, 2026, the second on December 18, 2026, and the third on March 11, 2027. December 18 also has a two-hour early dismissal. October 9 and March 11 are not marked as student holidays.

faqs.question: When is graduation, and where can families find ceremony details?
faqs.answer: Graduation is listed for Friday, May 21, 2027. The annual calendar does not give a ceremony time, venue or rehearsal schedule. Families of graduating students should use the high school’s graduation announcements for those details.

faqs.question: How many school days are in the Baker County 2026-2027 calendar?
faqs.answer: The district's official calendar lists 176 student days for the 2026-2027 school year. Early dismissal days still count as school days, while holidays and teacher planning days without classes do not.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official Baker County 2026-2027 school calendar?
faqs.answer: The Baker County School District Calendar page provides the 2026-2027 At-A-Glance School Calendar and the Student Holiday & Early Dismissal Guide. The guide includes Homecoming early dismissal and the dates students return after major breaks. Check the district's Calendar page for updates.
